notes: Cash basis; school district with a governmental funds statement (Total Governmental Funds column, p6, labels from p7) and a School Nutrition proprietary (business-type) fund (p8). Governmental roll-forward: 17,746,509 + 60,509,211 - 59,833,358 disbursements - 33,014 transfers out = 18,389,348 (the statement's total disbursements 59,866,372 include the 33,014 transfer to School Nutrition, after eliminating 248,082 of internal transfers). Transfer 33,014 matches the business-type transfer from general fund (p8, p17). Business-type: 1,899,332 + 2,738,816 receipts (operating 438,769 + nonoperating 2,300,047) - 2,870,559 + 33,014 transfer = 1,800,603. Taxes 11,730,617 split using the General Fund budget schedule (p9): property 10,491,669 + Bond 131 + QCPU 14,588, carline 3,850, motor vehicle 1,220,379 (public power sales tax 45,080 is not in the statement Taxes line; it sits in Other local receipts). Other local receipts 1,467,154 split by fund schedules; each piece shows its source pages. Non-revenue receipts 124,518 split into insurance adjustments 21,175 and other 103,343 (unexplained). Instruction and Central services statement rows include Student Fee Fund (8,345) and Activity Fund (555,860) spending; split out as student activities. USDA and State subsidy 2,232,157 split into federal 2,215,068 and state 17,089 per p17. Balance sheet uses the Statement of Net Position Total column (p1); the printed row 'Total assets and liabilities 20,189,951' is assets less the single liability. ending_cash is the governmental fund balance total 18,389,348 (includes 2,292,130 due from County Treasurer, less 7,517 due to other government). Detail: General Fund receipts from the budgetary comparison (pp9-10); General Fund spending from the supporting schedule of cash disbursements by program and object (pp22-28), which supersedes the function-only lines of the budget schedule (p10), so budget_final is omitted for those; General Fund detail totals include the transfers (6,935 in receipts, 274,161 out in disbursements, recorded as other financing). Activity Fund recorded account by account (pp18-20) with its transfers column as other financing; the activity schedule transfers total 234,212 versus 241,147 in the statement (difference 6,935 is the activity-to-general transfer). Employee Benefit, Special Building, Bond have no printed total disbursements/revenue totals except the unlabeled revenue subtotals recorded. Hidden-transfer check: no transfers inside spending lines; transfers to Activity and School Nutrition (33,014) are the separate General Fund transfers of 274,161. Depreciation Fund budgeted transfer 1,200,000 and Employee Benefit budgeted transfer 466,984 had zero actual. Read pages 1-28 of 28
